test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the option in which all the words are spelt correctly.

options.text: The sage preached that we are accountable to God in this life.
The sage preached that we are akountable to God in this life.
The sage preached that we are accuuntable to God in this life
The sage preached that we are acountable to God in this life.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sage preached that we are accountable to God in this life.
 
• In English, the word **"accountable"** is spelled with two "c"s and one "t".
 
• **It means** responsible or answerable.
 
• This spelling is correctly used in the first sentence.
